description: List sent email logs (delivery history) with optional pagination and filters; use to debug delivery issues.

category.description: Filter by email category. Use with category_operator. Single value, array (e.g. ["Newsletter", "Alert"]), or comma-separated string (e.g. "Newsletter,Alert") for multiple (OR).

oneOf.description: Multiple category values (OR). Logs matching any value are returned.

clicks_count.description: Filter by number of link clicks. Use with clicks_count_operator.

client_ip.description: Filter by client IP. Use with client_ip_operator.

email_service_provider.description: Filter by email service provider (exact). Single value or array. Use with *_operator.

email_service_provider_response.description: Filter by provider response text. Single value or array. Use with *_operator.

events.description: Filter by event type(s). Use with events_operator: include_event or not_include_event.

events_operator.description: Operator for events filter. Default: include_event.

from_email.description: Filter by sender email (use with from_operator). Single value or array.

from_operator.description: Operator for from_email filter. Default: ci_equal. ci_contain/ci_not_contain match substring; ci_equal/ci_not_equal match exactly (case-insensitive).

opens_count.description: Filter by number of opens. Use with opens_count_operator.

recipient_mx.description: Filter by recipient MX. Single value or array. Use with recipient_mx_operator.

search_after.description: Pagination cursor from the previous response's next_page_cursor to fetch the next page

sending_domain_id.description: Filter by sending domain ID. Single value or array. Find IDs in Mailtrap Sending Domains.

sending_domain_id_operator.description: Operator for sending_domain_id filter. Default: equal.

sending_ip.description: Filter by sending IP. Use with sending_ip_operator.

sending_stream.description: Filter by sending stream: transactional or bulk. Single value or array.

sending_stream_operator.description: Operator for sending_stream filter. Default: equal.

sent_after.description: ISO 8601 date/time; only return logs for emails sent after this time

sent_before.description: ISO 8601 date/time; only return logs for emails sent before this time

status.description: Filter by delivery status (use with status_operator). Single value or array.

status_operator.description: Operator for status filter. Default: equal.

subject.description: Filter by email subject (use with subject_operator). Single value or array. Omit for empty/not_empty.

subject_operator.description: Operator for subject filter. Default: ci_contain. Use empty/not_empty to filter by presence of subject.

to_email.description: Filter by recipient email (use with to_operator). Single value or array.

to_operator.description: Operator for to_email filter. Default: ci_equal.

name: list-email-logs
